name: RTI-112
summary: RTI(-4229)-112 (2β-carbomethoxy-3β-(3-methyl-4-chlorophenyl)tropane) is a synthetic stimulant drug from the phenyltropane family. It is primarily used in scientific research to study the brain's reward system. In contrast to more well-known stimulants that primarily affect one type of brain cell communication, RTI-112 is a nonselective triple reuptake inhibitor.

pharmacology.text: Nonselective analogs are less likely to function as "reinforcers" than reuptake inhibitors that have DAT specificity. RTI-112 has equipotent in vitro affinity at the SERT, NET and DAT, respectively. RTI-112 was not reliably self-administered, in contrast to the DAT selective reuptake inhibitors that were used in this study.

uses.text: It is primarily used in scientific research to study the brain's reward system. RTI-112 was not reliably self-administered, in contrast to the DAT selective reuptake inhibitors that were used in this study.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: RTI-112 blocks all three monoamine transporters at once. Researchers use such balanced compounds to ask whether blocking serotonin alongside dopamine makes a stimulant less reinforcing.
fact.zh: RTI-112 會同時阻斷三種單胺轉運蛋白。研究人員用這類作用均衡的化合物，來探討同時阻斷血清素和多巴胺是否會降低興奮劑的成癮強化作用。
fact.zhHans: RTI-112 会同时阻断三种单胺转运蛋白。研究人员用这类作用均衡的化合物，来探讨同时阻断血清素和多巴胺是否会降低兴奋剂的成瘾强化作用。
